# v2026.10.49

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.49.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.49.md).

This release covers **11 pull requests, with thanks to 1 contributor.**

## Highlights

- Xero clients become Flow contacts, and contact edits go both ways (opt in on the Xero page). ([#346](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/346))
- New Seazona clients become Flow contacts, and Link ties a contact to its Xero client. ([#340](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/340))
- On a phone, lists, settings rows, invoice lines and touch targets fit the screen. ([#341](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/341), [#343](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/343))
- Integration pages say less: a name, ? help and short notices. ([#347](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/347))
- Folded sections point right when closed and down when open. ([#348](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/348))

## Changes

- New Seazona clients become Flow contacts, and Link ties a contact to its Xero client. ([#340](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/340))
- Phone parts in the design system, and phone checks for cut tables and split notices. ([#342](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/342))
- Xero clients become Flow contacts, and contact edits go both ways (opt in on the Xero page). ([#346](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/346))

## Fixes

- On a phone the Pending note is one short line, and invoice lines stack as cards. ([#341](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/341))
- Drop the Dependabot cooldown option GitHub Actions rejects. ([#344](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/344))
- Phone lists, settings rows and touch targets fit a phone. ([#343](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/343))
- Integration pages say less: name and ? help, short notices, slim header. ([#347](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/347))
- 5 highlights is a guideline for a stable release, not a release gate. ([#345](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/345))
- Folded sections point right when closed, down when open. ([#348](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/348))
